description: This Java class defines constants, enums, and utility methods for handling credentials within the Eclipse Hono project, including JSON request creation, secret property extraction, and action validation.

classes.name: CredentialsConstants
classes.description: A final class containing constants, enums, and static utility methods for credential handling in the Credentials API.

classes.name: CredentialsConstants.CredentialsAction
classes.description: An enum representing actions (get, add, update, unknown) for the Credentials API, with methods to construct from strings and validate.

methods.name: getSearchCriteria
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with search criteria for credentials based on type and authId.

methods.name: getServiceGetRequestAsJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON request object for internal communication via vert.x event bus, including tenant, deviceId, authId, and type.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the hash function used for a hashed-password secret from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Retrieves the password hash from a secret JsonObject.

methods.name: getPasswordSalt
methods.description: Retrieves the password salt from a secret JsonObject, or null if not present.
